	            <div class="wpb-content-wrapper"><div data-vc-full-width="true" data-vc-full-width-temp="true" data-vc-full-width-init="false" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid w-overlay vc_custom_1726800935762 vc_row-has-fill"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"> <h1 style="color:#ffffff;padding:px;text-align:center;font-size:50px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="  text-50  ">KITEBOARDING COURSES</h1> </div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row-full-width vc_clearfix"></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1659523614179"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>Habagat Kiteboarding Center is and International Kiteboarding Organization (IKO) affiliated kite school and offers IKO courses for beginners and advanced riders. Experience kiteboarding through our Introductio Course, continue your education if you&#8217;ve already started, or take our full course and go from beginner to kiter!</p>
